parts.latex: For connected networks, which of the following is NOT true?

solutions.latex:
Option A is true: a network with equal edge weights can have several minimum spanning trees.

Option B is true: two different routes can have the same shortest length.

Option D is true: the sum of the degrees is twice the number of edges.

Option C is not true: a shortest path between two vertices need not use only edges of the minimum spanning tree, since the tree minimises total length, not individual path lengths.

So the statement that is NOT true is option C.

parts.latex: How many edges on the network diagram would form a minimum spanning tree?

Asia Insight Airlines offers two direct flights from the city of Thimphu, Bhutan:

Thimphu to Seoul for \$630 and Thimphu to Dili for \$350.

What is the length of the minimum spanning tree that includes Thimphu?

solutions.latex:
A spanning tree on $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. There are $8$ cities.
$$\begin{aligned} n-1 &= 8-1 \\ &= 7 \text{ edges} \end{aligned}$$

Choosing the cheapest edges that join all cities without forming a cycle gives the minimum spanning tree.

\exfigure{722_q13_s1}

The edges are Almaty–Chennai $330$, Almaty–Yerevan $485$, Yerevan–Bishkek $450$, Bishkek–Kabul $275$, Kabul–Dili $370$, Bishkek–Xi'an $445$, Xi'an–Seoul $620$.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Length} &= 330 + 485 + 450 + 370 + 275 + 445 + 620 \\ &= 2975 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{length of minimum spanning tree} = \$2975$$
criteria: Draws a correct tree or finds the correct length, or equivalent merit

meta.format_note: Sketch drawn (722_q13_s1); it was to show: minimum spanning tree on the eight cities with edges Almaty–Chennai 330, Almaty–Yerevan 485, Yerevan–Bishkek 450, Bishkek–Kabul 275, Kabul–Dili 370, Bishkek–Xi'an 445, Xi'an–Seoul 620; total 2975. Rubric written by us. Source lists the edges as 7 and sum is consistent. Thimphu is not among the listed cities in the source tree, so part (c) adds the cheapest Thimphu edge 350.

solutions.latex:
Thimphu is not yet in the tree, so join it by its cheaper flight, to Dili for $\$350$.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Length} &= 2975 + 350 \\ &= 3325 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{length} = \$3325$$

meta.format_note: The source's tree in (b) has 8 vertices already; adding Thimphu implies a ninth city, consistent with the source answer.
